snippet.title: Super Mario 3D All-Stars DELUXE PC Trailer
snippet.description:
A collection of 5 3D Mario games, pre-configured optimally to make setting up these games a breeze. *Simply drag and drop your roms and play!

Install guide:
https://youtu.be/JHCXjnGd1Gg

Learn more here!
https://gitlab.com/Minibattle/super-mario-3d-all-stars-deluxe

🍵 Ko-fi if you would like to support me (completely optional):
https://ko-fi.com/minibattlelop

Made by me, launcher by https://www.youtube.com/@hazzyjc
